findings.summary: Audit-emission tests for the read_counts deny path (f82b) and mark_taken_down takedown/re-mark (093c) assert only that an audit event is emitted, not the full field set. SPEC §5 'Audit events' requires every event carry {subject, action, resource, decision, timestamp, reason}; only the read_original_url test (e71a) asserts that field set. A test that checks emission but not field completeness passes even if the deny/takedown event omits subject, decision, or reason — defeating the traceability the SPEC names (detecting unauthorized takedown / denied count read).
findings.recommendation: Promote f82b and 093c to type: security and assert the full {subject, action, resource, decision, timestamp, reason} field set on their audit events, matching e71a. For 093c, assert the takedown event identifies the acting subject and decision so an unauthorized takedown of a live code is attributable.

findings.location: §4 increment_visit (TDD.01.04.3c6f / 4d70 / d609); SPEC §3 delivery contract, DFD Count path
findings.summary: The increment_visit operation crosses a trust boundary (SPEC DFD 'Count path': code + event_id arriving off a durable async dispatch queue) but has no input-fuzzing test. d609 covers only producer/consumer version-skew (in-window vs out-of-window dead-letter); 4d8f and 81c3 fuzz the put_mapping URL and resolve/mark_taken_down ShortCode, but neither covers the event payload. A malformed/oversized/encoding-edge/injection event_id or code decoded from the transport is an un-fuzzed boundary input — the deserialization surface flagged by ADR-01's threat model is only tested for version skew, not for hostile payload content.
findings.recommendation: Add a type: security (CWE-20) fuzzing case on increment_visit: malformed/oversized/encoding-edge/injection event_id and code (and any decoded event field) are rejected to dead-letter before mutating VisitCountRecord, never best-effort decoded. Also fuzz put_mapping's ShortCode parameter (currently only resolve/mark_taken_down ShortCode is fuzzed by 81c3, though §5 names the allowlist as a precondition on put_mapping too).
